inherits.scope: Keep v4 and everything it inherits immutable: schema, official 256000-byte body validation, trusted stages, null local caps, request and policy binding. v5 only adds the observed model labels below to the inherited accepted_observed_model_labels.

context_evidence.statement: jev-1.14.0 default limits are unchanged from 1.13: 64k tokens per request and 32k for state plus the longest question; 262k only with an explicit long-context opt-in, which this project does not send. Released 2026-10-14 as jev-preview; jev-latest moves to 1.14.0 about a week later.
Lists jev-1.14.0 among Jev models with the same Jev model context (64k tokens) and state-plus-longest-question (32k tokens) limits.
jev-preview resolves to jev-1.14.0 since 2026-10-14; the validator limits are separate from model context limits.

dated_build_basis: typesafe/jev-1.14-20261014 is not named in the docs; it was returned by the provider for requests to jev-latest (D086, R20261019-PAID-H2-OPENAPI jev-0014) and is the only 1.14 dated build in jev-settlement-models.v1.json. Future builds and moving 1.14 aliases are not accepted.
